plan: Freeze the initial session shape in a module-level _INITIAL_SESSION template so construction, begin, and abandon all derive the exact four-key dictionary from one source.

In __init__, defensively copy appointments into id/label dictionaries, precompute the id set for membership checks, store the optional action_source and screen_sink, and initialize the public session from the template.
Route handle() through a dispatch table keyed by action type, with a dict-type and type-string guard in front so malformed actions become error screens instead of exceptions.

Structure every handler as guard-then-mutate: validate session state first, then payload shape, and only mutate session after all checks pass, guaranteeing rejected actions never corrupt accepted data.

Centralize screen construction in a _screen factory that attaches appointment choices exactly when the prompt is 'Choose appointment' and empty choices otherwise, and build error screens from a _current_prompt function that derives the next unmet step from session state.

Implement run_once as pure dependency injection: raise RuntimeError before touching either collaborator if one is missing, then read one action, handle it, display the resulting screen exactly once, and return that same screen object so unittest fakes can assert identity.
mechanisms: Module-level _INITIAL_SESSION template with in-place session.update() resets, keeping external references to the public session dictionary valid across begin/abandon
Dispatch table (_HANDLERS) mapping the six action-type strings to per-action handler methods
Guard-then-mutate handler discipline: complete state and payload validation before any session write
Single _screen factory enforcing the choices-present-iff-prompt-is-'Choose appointment' invariant and the exact prompt/messages/choices key set
_current_prompt derivation of the next unmet step, reused for accepted corrections and for error-screen prompts
Constructor-time defensive copy of appointments plus a precomputed id set for O(1) known-id validation
Constructor-injected action_source/screen_sink collaborators with a RuntimeError precondition in run_once checked before either is invoked
